newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.

text.p: After hours activity was light, traders said Friday, with shares trading in line with thier closing prices.
"I really don't see that much going on," said one trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said that Angelica Corp and Zurn Industries Inc were unavailable for after hours trade for news on Friday.
The NYSE said that session one volume was 4,800 shares, compared to 3,100 shares on Thursday. Session two volume was 5,074,878 shares, compared to no activity on Thursday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
